messages:
Jess (PM): ok team — need a quick sync on Q2 GTM targets and the PLG experiments we promised sellers. I sketched priorities in the doc: https://go.redwood/plg-q2-playbook
Sam (Sales): link pls, want to make sure commit numbers are realistic. our Q2 target: `+25% ARR` is on the board
Hana (Growth): I'm proposing 3 experiments: (1) onboarding NPS gating for new dev signups, (2) trial-to-paid nudges in console, (3) code samples + starter apps. each mapped to a 3-week sprint
Leo (Marketing): we can support (3) with a launch kit and 2 blog posts. need creative by week 2
Jess (PM): sellers need clear launch criteria for the PLG features: activation lift >= 8% OR conversion RR >= 12% and no more than 0.5% support tickets spike. OK?
Omar (RevOps): that sounds fine. which territories? EU needs specific legal sign-off for experiment telemetry
Maria (SE): also want enablement content — 1-pager + call script + demo gif. can we freeze the playbook by Tue? @Sam
Sam (Sales): Tue is tight but doable if Growth and Marketing turn assets by Mon EOD. I'll push sellers to prep their target lists
Hana (Growth): team, experiment infra: we'll use `feature-flag: plg-code-samples` with cohorts A/B. I'll create cohorts and set metrics in Amplitude
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Q2 GTM rapid sync — Thu 10:00am — Zoom link
Leo (Marketing): can ops commit to one webinar slot for partners? partner webinar drives highest lift historically
Omar (RevOps): yes — put the slot in. I'll add tracking tags: `campaign=plg-q2` `source=partners`
Jess (PM): final ask — decide canary rollout guardrails. if conversion drops by >2pp in any cohort we rollback. thumbs? :thumbsup:
Sam (Sales): 👍
Hana (Growth): 👍
Leo (Marketing): 👍
Maria (SE): 👍
Jess (PM): great, I'll update the playbook and ping the thread when assets land. thanks!
